sloka: अभुद्धिर्बत नो राजा जीवलोकम् चरत्ययम् ।यो गतिम् सर्वभूतानाम् परित्यजति राघवम् ॥२-२०-५॥
transliteration: abhuddhirbata no rājā jīvalokam caratyayam ।yo gatim sarvabhūtānām parityajati rāghavam ॥2-20-5॥

translations.english: Alas our king who has lost his brain, who has ordered the banishment of Rama, the refuge of all living beings, (on the other hand) is moving about in the world.
